source.qualification_context: Root is separately qualifying 0081; no result from that candidate is inferred here.

scope_zh: 新增一个显式、有限、预装的 A→Learning→C 同会话 profile。保持同一实际 daemon actor、PID、boot/start ticks、spawn/Fleet Running、Root PID/session、writer lease/proof 和原角色权限。只完成一次 learning scope 安装与一次后继 C；C 的原反馈可持久化，但不把该一次令牌变成无限循环或冷重启权限。
authorization_delta_zh: 必须显式新增的授权事实只有：由同一可信 Root host 在 serve 前保管的 non-Clone 一次 phase capability，允许该原 live session 在真实 A/Outcome/Prepared 后装入唯一 scope；以及预装固定 daemon controller 内的唯一任务阶段转交。不能把旧 CURRENT publication cap、字符串 source ID、JSON 或已取走的 connection 升级成该权限。原业务角色、key、FinalUse、签名窗口、scope 和 effect-owner 权限不扩大。

The public reservation function opens another registered writer/service at its start. It must NOT be called as a live-session shortcut. Extract its unchanged reserve body into a narrow method on the retained same service, preserving all original with_learning_profile, original file/witness/CAS and before/after expiry checks.

It requires existing registered Learning. A narrow internal constructor from the actual newly installed RegisteredHostLearningCheckpointV1 is needed; the old cap must not acquire general Learning/Model enrollment.

existing_breakpoints.missing: Preinstall one concrete phase controller and stable handles before A. Do not reconstruct Config after run or replace OnceLock values with arbitrary owners.

existing_breakpoints.missing: Add a distinct concrete phased route before A; neither changing an existing Direct enum nor starting today's Pending slot can produce A.

existing_breakpoints.missing: A controller-owned task-local admission barrier and original worker drain/join are needed around it; global Supervisor Draining is not a reversible pause.

existing_breakpoints.missing: Extract the same closed assembly into a private phase join consuming actual original inputs; leave the Config wrapper's behavior unchanged. New running controller owns the delayed bootstrap instead of fabricating a configured Config.

After real Root scope registration, activate the one exact original source in the preinstalled phase registry and call this original bounded reconciliation on the same journal/AutomationStore. No redispatch or fake startup record.

existing_breakpoints.exists: Initial vs learned handoffs are mutually exclusive in the ordinary parser; RootGenerationPublicationConnectionV1 is non-Clone and single-take
existing_breakpoints.missing: A separate explicit phased entry needs ordered distinct phase-specific offers/context construction. The ordinary parser and old single-take API remain unchanged; no cloning, returning or rearming an already consumed connection.

All new late Learning, Model and publication phase worker adapters must inherit the original startup absolute end and apply the minimum with original cap/lease/request deadlines. Passing an old full relative lifetime or recomputing a fresh interval when a phase starts is forbidden; do not mutate the retained config to hide a renewal.

proposed_interfaces.returns: Non-Clone/non-Serialize RootQ24PhaseEnrollmentCapabilityV1 held only by the original Root host, plus a sealed fixed-purpose phase offer. It does not create a learning checkpoint or guess the future batch-derived scope.

proposed_interfaces.inputs: Actual original A task/runtime/ledger capabilities, full original identity and session, original task queue/store, typed future-role handoff holders, phase offer; original Primary remains mandatory.
proposed_interfaces.returns: Stable concrete task handle/provider, one-use host phase handle and scoped progress/readback. Installed once before A in the ordinary runtime; no dyn replacement owner callback.

proposed_interfaces.inputs: Same original one-use cap and Root-owned late material describing the actual Prepared-derived initial/scope, original Model reservation/local policy and exact material digest, all checked against the fixed phase and real current authority.
proposed_interfaces.effect: Claim phase record first; register/open Learning and reserve/open Model on the same serving service; bind their actual lanes, seal the distinct purpose offers; record actual committed bindings. Existing/partial namespaces never become fresh state.

proposed_interfaces.inputs: Actual original Prepared/retained cap, original E/D/Training/LocalDecision inputs and verified same-session scoped Root offers.
proposed_interfaces.effect: Reuse exact original owner checks and bootstrap conversion once; activate same-source delivery and original outbox reconciliation inside the fixed controller. Caller data cannot manufacture these input capabilities.

proposed_interfaces.inputs: Exact operation, phase and original caller/session correlation.
proposed_interfaces.effect: Return only original retained phase record/progress/digests. Status never issues a new capability, lease, signature, owner or task dispatch.

binding_and_custody.custody: Root and daemon pin actual PID/boot/start ticks, full AgentdIdentity and original verifier/Root pidfd. No new Starting, peer substitution or copied serialized liveness token.

Pin exact writer proof, lease ID/generation, authority epoch and original role trust; revalidate original current authority at each mutation. No public fake-now parameter. Keep 500ms freshness, request-start age, ceiling and sticky failure.

Root reserves one operation/source-A intent and one allowed Learning/C transition before A; names/data are correlation only. Actual source, completed receipt, rule.digest(real batch), initial and FrozenLearningScope are installed only after they exist.

Controller owns the actual PublishedTask/Cell/source/provider while A runs. Capture real Prepared and retained read-only source before relinquishing writable A custody; then actual task-local drain and bounded join. Retained facts must not keep retired writer locks alive.

Authenticated Outcome is still produced by the existing independent enrolled Observer; Generator/Evaluator/Selector/trainer journals, witnesses, keys, trust and real evaluation inputs come from original owners. A phase slot does not grant their roles or presume a pre-A signer covers an unknown future scope.

Daemon Prepared notification alone cannot invoke Root installation. The trusted same-PID Root cap holder supplies exact Root-owned pinned late material, using existing nofollow/Root0600/directory-pin practices. Keep the existing registration TCB: do not claim Root independently observed private Cell or HQ2 facts merely by receiving a digest. The daemon actual cap validates those facts; any new independent Root source reader would be a separately scoped requirement.

Initial-A, Learning, Model and learned-C use separate purpose offers and sequence domains from the same original session. Future scope-dependent offers are sealed only after actual scope installation. Do not reuse the old generic connection or old Initial client.

Capture the original Root session/cap absolute end at initial startup; all late accepts/exchanges use that same end, bounded also by the original lease and Learning request expiry. Both Learning and Model serve_optional currently start Instant::now()+lifetime_ms. New internal live-phase serve adapters, including any late publication route, must take the original absolute end rather than reinvoke a relative-lifetime wrapper. Do not silently renew by recomputing remaining before a later now()+remaining, changing config or resetting an existing deadline.

A Root-protected one-use phase record distinguishes Reserved, Claimed, Scoped and Closed/Uncertain; the controller retains actual component receipts and causes. Persisted metadata is not a restorable live capability after Root/daemon restart.

root_state_machine.allowed: Original five lanes and original Initial-A purpose; no Learning/Model namespace yet. Actual scope is unknown.
root_state_machine.transition: Only the same Root cap may accept exact actual post-A material once.

root_state_machine.allowed: One matching material digest/operation has consumed the installation right before first namespace/file mutation.
root_state_machine.transition: Execute original register/open/reserve/bind/seal sequence; no second create or automatic retry. Partial errors remain Claimed/Uncertain.

root_state_machine.allowed: Original Learning/Model lanes and ordered C publication route are attached to this actual backend; each offered writable right is transferred at most once.
root_state_machine.transition: Continue only under original service lifetime. Readback is observational; failed/lost offer delivery does not mint another offer.

root_state_machine.allowed: Original diagnostic/read-only status when its original authority permits.
root_state_machine.transition: Absorbing for execution. Cancellation, revocation, EOF/lost phase ACK, deadline or unknown effect cannot rearm the cap.

daemon_phase_machine.admission: Only exact original A route and actual signed RunStart; independently arriving business Outcome uses the original producer.

Atomically stop new A drive enqueue under the same admission linearization as phase transition; preserve queued/inflight pending accounting including lost callers. Reject C and never redirect a queued A request.
daemon_phase_machine.work: Wait for original admitted work/readback and real Automation unresolved blockers. Freeze actual material and capture retained source while original checks still hold.

Call original drain_completed_task, verify actual durable drain, stop/join only the owned A loop after pending reaches zero, release obsolete write owners. Keep actual Prepared/retained completion and original session.

Request/receive actual one-use Root scope join; original source/trust/factory/owner checks; register exact retained source and reconcile the original outbox. A retained source ID alone never becomes Ready.

daemon_phase_machine.admission: Original learning worker runs under its actual required-port/admission/source gates. Ordinary app/runtime readiness is not forged.
daemon_phase_machine.work: Original E/D/Training/Model/B/LocalDecision sequence; actual immutable receipts. Wait for later publication material outside the aggregate lane.

daemon_phase_machine.admission: No task drive until actual installation is complete.
daemon_phase_machine.work: Use original qualified or legitimate retained publication phase, actual independent Selection and FinalUse, original Root CURRENT, actual target journals and original successor channel. Same cancel/admission checks immediately before effects and after results; never return a substituted Task.

daemon_phase_machine.admission: Only exact new C publication/source/RunStart under the same actor; A requests cannot execute via C.
daemon_phase_machine.work: Original installed ingress plus actual private completion. Optional OriginalLedger feedback can persist actual C decision/independent Outcome for a future Dataset; it does not enroll a second scope.

Completed requires actual ordinary C evidence. Fault records exact original cause/uncertainty and invokes the required owner's existing shutdown/fence behavior; missing input or expired work is not NoUpdate.

effect_and_failure_rules: Root registration, factory reservation and CURRENT/FinalUse mutations remain inside their original dispatch-witness boundaries; do not relocate filesystem validation or effects outside the witness merely to shorten latency.

No holding a Root witness, original consumer lock, A task owner lock or aggregate lane while awaiting peer messages, five-lane acceptance, unknown Outcome, B execution, Selection, or phase ACK. Bind then accept in owned workers.

Root registration and Model reservation are not one filesystem transaction. Claim the outer phase before either; record partial provenance and return typed uncertainty after possible effects. Never infer Missing means permission to re-genesis.
After phase-command cancellation, lost phase ACK or revocation, keep the one-use phase closed. Inflight effects still drain/join and are recorded; no hard abort creates a false clean slot.

Existing ordinary A/C acknowledgement-loss readback remains valid observation of the same operation. It may prove an already completed task but must not replay inference, renew a signature or rearm a consumed phase. Separate task transport uncertainty from phase installation uncertainty.

Old Initial-purpose completion/EOF may finish only its own phase worker after exact expected completion; it must not silently stop the original observation/consumer service or be blanket-ignored. Unexpected closure remains a failure. Preserve ordinary non-phased EOF/Drop semantics.
Any original source withdrawal, authority failure, clock regression, request-age expiry or session Drop remains fail-closed. The phase controller does not clear a fence or update an old cache.
Do not use global Supervisor Draining/Exited or Neuron resume as this phase barrier. The actor remains the same actual Running incarnation and still must satisfy every effect's normal admission gate.
Readback after process/Root restart does not resurrect this phase. Cold recovery is outside V1; no serialized cap, same-PID reopen recipe or changed start ticks can resume execution.

minimal_implementation_slices.limit: One purpose and one actual scope, no generic admin/install callback; reserve-body extraction on same service with exact existing guards.
New explicit profile's private inventory only; old one-shot context and existing Initial/learned parser contracts unchanged.
One concrete stable handle/provider/required worker, exact atomic queue admission cut and controlled joins; no mutable trait-owner replacement.
Reuse original actual-owner constructor checks and bounded history reconciliation. Private one-use source registration activates only after actual scope match.

Explicit typed embedded-host composition first; actual original Primary, business Observer and B/Selector inputs remain required. A future CLI descriptor adapter must locate such real owners, not construct fake capabilities from JSON.

required_external_facts: Complete actual Primary deployment (Android MCP or Notes/UI or Desktop), original Root and actual same-actor startup/process/FD proofs.
Actual original A PublishedTask/source/Cell, Circuit runtime/model/route/fence/files and authenticated ordinary Objective; no fixture source or synthetic completion.
Existing enrolled independent Observer's actual terminal business Outcome with true value/timestamps/publication binding, and original Generator/Ledger capabilities.

Actual original Evaluator freeze capabilities plus E/D Observer, Trainer/Generator, LocalDecision/Selector owner resources/trust for the actual frozen scope; unknown future scope cannot be preauthorized by this design.
For adoption: real independent B execution and holdout/parent baseline/fair budget/complete costs. For every allowed C path: actual independent selection and original FinalUse issuance.
Actual new C request/input/source distinct from A as required by existing Feature checks; a copied A observation or receipt is not independent C.
Trusted Root host material supply for the single post-A scope registration; daemon notification is not that authority.

acceptance_cases.case: Actual ordinary same-actor A→signed independent Outcome→real HQ2/Prepared→original task-local drain→late Root join→natural original TrainingNoUpdate→actual retained parent C.
acceptance_cases.assert: Root/daemon PID, boot/start, full identity, lease/proof and original source/receipt times are unchanged; ordinary C is real, not component checkpoint fabrication.

acceptance_cases.case: Actual qualified adoption with original B/holdout/fair-cost material.
acceptance_cases.assert: Original B full manifest becomes exact publication, independent Selection and actual FinalUse/CURRENT; actual C independently executes on its own input.

acceptance_cases.case: Real RetainParent and signed DeferCandidate branches.
acceptance_cases.assert: Both reach permitted parent C, retain original category/receipt and publish no replacement Artifact.

acceptance_cases.case: Concurrent A submit at ClosingA; admitted queue, in-flight lost caller and unresolved durable Circuit work.
acceptance_cases.assert: One admission cut, no old request redirected to C, pending does not clear before actual completion, no premature Root join.

acceptance_cases.case: Wrong Root/daemon PID/start/spawn, foreign scope/source/cell/lease/purpose/operation or descriptor replacement.
acceptance_cases.assert: Reject before effect; original files/current/claims remain unchanged when no effect was entered.

acceptance_cases.case: Repeated scope request, pre-existing or partial namespace, lost Root registration/offer ACK.
acceptance_cases.assert: Original phase remains consumed; no new namespace repair, second writer rights, signature or reset. Preserve exact committed/uncertain evidence.

acceptance_cases.case: Cancel/revoke/session Drop before claim, during registration and during actual FinalUse/CURRENT work.
acceptance_cases.assert: Original no-effect refusal or typed post-effect uncertainty; inflight work is joined, future phase stays closed.

acceptance_cases.case: Missing/expired/forged Observer Outcome, wrong actor separation, stale Prepared or nonoriginal training/B source.
acceptance_cases.assert: No Ready or NoUpdate substitution, no new business signature, original current/source/role/time gates remain.

acceptance_cases.case: Swap Initial and learned-C offers; replay a consumed connection; send old A objective after C activation.
acceptance_cases.assert: Reject exact wrong phase without cloning/rearming a connection or dispatching an old task.

acceptance_cases.case: Original five-lane observation while post-A registration/owner work is active, including a scope that becomes available near the original session deadline.
acceptance_cases.assert: No accept/witness/aggregate lock cycle, no clock/freshness-window extension; Learning, Model and C cannot outlive the original absolute end. All original public liveness gates remain authoritative.

acceptance_cases.case: C with OriginalLedger feedback plus independent C Outcome; NonLearning branch separately.
acceptance_cases.assert: Real next Dataset only for actual enrolled feedback; NonLearning remains explicit, no automatic next Root scope or fake business label.

acceptance_cases.case: Drop/restart Root or daemon and replay persisted phase bytes.
acceptance_cases.assert: No live capability restoration or cold-restart success claim; readback remains original evidence only.

qualification_limits: All cases above are planned, not implemented or executed. Preserve prior failures. New source, caller guards, QA and actual component/ordinary tests require a later fixed candidate and Root-owned full qualification. Current ordinary complete/adoption/NoUpdate-or-rollback counts remain 0/0/0; independent C and physical daemon+Root restart remain unaccepted.

design_review.kind: Bounded peer static design review communicated to author; not an implementation/native acceptance
design_review.accepted_direction: Same-service reserve-body extraction and explicit new fixed-controller route; original task admission cut/pending custody/task-local drain/retained source/single Root join/outbox/independent C purposes, without treating existing Direct, OnceLock or consumed Initial connection as reusable.
design_review.correction_in_v2: Explicitly includes Model's relative-lifetime wrapper, not just Learning, in the original-absolute-deadline obligation.
design_review.limits: No guarantee of compile/runtime feasibility or new API acceptance; no product source was changed.
